title: Made the AI spend section stand out
summary: We turned the plain strip of counters into a bolder block: the money spent on AI is now a huge inverted tile with an offset accent shadow, next to smaller raised cards for tokens, runs, PRs and days. Only layout and styling changed, so every number still comes straight from the generated data.

title: A guide to branches, labels and local git commands
summary: We added a closing section that shows how to push your own work and choose the outcome: review and auto-deploy, review only via a draft PR, or hand the whole thing to the agents with an issue label. The request asked about git tags, but we read the workflows and nothing is triggered by tags: the pipeline runs on branch prefixes, draft status and ai:* labels, so the section says that plainly. One caveat: we could only view the screenshots at thumbnail size, so the layout was checked less closely than usual.

title: Navigation highlights where you are on the page
summary: We added a small scroll-spy so the nav link for the section being read turns orange with an underline, and hover gets the same treatment. The sections are rendered from JSON after load, so instead of observing fixed positions we measure on scroll; the current link is also exposed with aria-current for screen readers.

title: v1 of the site: mission-control look, live counters, workflow diagram
summary: We replaced the placeholder with a lab-notebook-meets-mission-control design: graph-paper grid, serif headlines, monospace readouts, light and dark themes. Headline counters and per-agent numbers are read from site/data at runtime, and the approved how-it-works copy is rendered as a step-by-step workflow diagram with a highlighted human control point on every step. Day-one data is nearly all zeros, so we made every section fall back to dashes or plain empty states rather than hide.

title: The repo is born
summary: We scaffolded the repository, the agent rules in CLAUDE.md, the roadmap and the GitHub Actions pipeline that lets AI agents plan, build, review and deploy this site. This placeholder page is the last thing a human-directed session will write here.
